title: More Create!
description: More Create! delivers the ultimate vanilla+ engineering experience, packed with more Create addons than ever before! What will you automate?
body:
**More Create!** 


More Create! delivers the ultimate vanilla+ engineering experience, packed with more Create addons than ever before! What will you automate? 

More Create has all the Create mods you love! Whether it comes to automating trading or just random things to keep you entertained, I guarantee you will enjoy this modpack! 

**What's inside?** 

- All the Create Mods: Packed with tons of addons to give you endless automation and engineering options.

- Overhauled Exploration: Upgraded dungeons, end islands, mineshafts, nether fortresses, and strongholds to conquer and loot.

- Vanilla+ Vibe: Keeps the core Minecraft feel alive, giving you better structures to explore and massive mechanical potential to build with.
